name: tool-oneline
description: Folds tool calls in the scrollback into one line per call, or one line per run of calls, with no result block

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: calls: one line per tool call. runs: one line per run of calls between two assistant messages.

show.title: Always show
show.description: Tools drawn in full, with their output, and never folded into a run. Comma-separated tool names.
